## What to implement

New module `OctoPi.AI.Providers.Anthropic.Auth.OAuth` with:

```elixir
@spec refresh_token(String.t()) ::
  {:ok, %{access: String.t(), refresh: String.t(), expires_in: pos_integer()}} |
  {:error, term()}
def refresh_token(refresh_token)
```

POST to `https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token` with:
```json
{
  "grant_type": "refresh_token",
  "client_id": "<decoded CLIENT_ID>",
  "refresh_token": "<token>"
}
```
No `scope` field on refresh (upstream: scope is omitted from refresh grants).

Returns `{:ok, %{access: ..., refresh: ..., expires_in: ...}}` on 200, `{:error, reason}` otherwise.

## Constants (from upstream anthropic.ts)
- `CLIENT_ID` = `atob("OWQxYzI1MGEtZTYxYi00NGQ5LTg4ZWQtNTk0NGQxOTYyZjVl")` = `"9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e"`
- `TOKEN_URL` = `"https://platform.claude.com/v1/oauth/token"`

## Tests

Port the `refreshAnthropicToken` test case from `tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/test/anthropic-oauth.test.ts`:
- POST hits the correct URL
- body contains `grant_type: refresh_token`, `client_id`, `refresh_token` — but NOT `scope`
- returns parsed credentials on 200
- returns `{:error, _}` on non-200

Use `Req.Test` / `Plug` adapter to mock HTTP — same pattern as the existing `ProducerTest`.
